docs.title: 🔧 Generic CSV Provider
docs.text:
The Generic CSV Provider (broker_generic_csv) is the fallback import plugin for BRIM. It accepts any CSV file that follows the column conventions below — even if it does not come from a specifically supported broker.

One file per broker

Generic CSV must use one separate file per broker. Each file is assigned exactly one broker; never combine multiple brokers into one flat CSV. The wizard still allows multiple files and brokers, and multiple currencies for a single broker are valid — this is not one file per currency. This reflects the current parser flow, where broker_id is passed per file/parse, not a new restriction on monthly files.

docs.title: 🤖 Tip: Use an LLM to write your conversion script
docs.text:
The fastest way to import data from an unsupported source is to paste this entire page into an LLM and ask it to write a Python script that transforms your data into the Generic CSV format.

Suggested prompt

Here is the LibreFolio Generic CSV format specification:

[paste this page]

I have data in this format: 

[paste your file's header row and 2–3 sample rows]

Write a Python script that reads my file and produces a valid LibreFolio Generic CSV.

The LLM will produce a working script. Import the output CSV directly via BRIM.

Watch for sign convention errors — this is the most common mistake. See Sign Conventions below.

docs.title: ⭐ Key Features
docs.text:
• Header Auto-Detection: Does not rely on fixed column names — maintains a dictionary of common synonyms per field.
  • Flexible Date Parsing: Tries YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, and others automatically.
  • Flexible Number Parsing: Handles both US (1,234.56) and European (1.234,56) formats.
  • Transaction Type Mapping: Maps keywords (buy, acquisto, compra, …) to the TransactionType enum.
  • Low Priority: detection_priority = 0, so specific high-confidence plugins are always tried first.

docs.title: 📋 Column Mapping Reference
docs.text:
Column Required Description date ✅ Always Transaction date. Accepts 2023-12-31, 31/12/2023, etc. type ✅ Always One of: BUY, SELL, DIVIDEND, INTEREST, DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL, FEE, TAX, ADJUSTMENT quantity Depends on type Number of units. See Sign Conventions. amount Depends on type Net cash impact. See Sign Conventions. currency Optional ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD). Defaults to EUR. asset Depends on type Asset identifier. See Asset Identifier. description Optional Free text. Used as fallback for asset name resolution when no identifier is available.

TRANSFER, FX_CONVERSION and CASH_TRANSFER are rejected

Paired-leg types (TRANSFER, FX_CONVERSION, CASH_TRANSFER) require two transactions linked by link_uuid, which a flat CSV cannot express. The parser raises Unknown transaction type (or an explicit pairing error) for them. Use manual entry or a broker-specific plugin for paired movements.

docs.title: 🔢 Sign Conventions
docs.text:
This is the most common mistake when writing conversion scripts

LibreFolio uses an investor perspective for signs:

  • quantity: positive when you receive units, negative when you deliver units
  • amount: positive when cash enters your account, negative when cash leaves your account

docs.title: 📋 Per-type quick reference
docs.text:
Type quantity sign amount sign Notes BUY + (receive units) − (pay cash) e.g. quantity=10, amount=-1500.00 SELL − (deliver units) + (receive cash) e.g. quantity=-1, amount=+62.36 DIVIDEND none (0 or empty) + Cash distribution received INTEREST none + Interest income received DEPOSIT none + Cash entering the broker account WITHDRAWAL none − Cash leaving the broker account FEE none − Commission or fee paid TAX none − Tax or withholding paid ADJUSTMENT + or − must be empty Quantity-only correction (splits, gifts, inheritance seeding). No cash movement.

Inherited cost basis (WAC) is PER-UNIT

An ADJUSTMENT row that seeds an inherited or transferred position (you owned it before, with a known purchase cost) carries a frozen cost basis. The generic CSV has no cost_basis column, so the import wizard prompts you to fill it ("Missing inherited per-unit cost basis (WAC)"). Enter the cost per single unit (e.g. 42.50 for a share bought at €42.50), not the position's total value. The engine multiplies it by quantity; a total entered here inflates the cost basis by a factor of quantity. For bonds, quantity is the face value and the per-unit cost is near 1.0.

docs.title: 🏷️ Asset Identifier
docs.text:
The asset column accepts:

  • Ticker (e.g. AAPL, VWCE) — for exchange-listed securities
  • ISIN (e.g. US0378331005) — preferred when available; unambiguous across exchanges
  • Name / description (e.g. VIA SILONE, MARINA DI SCARLINO) — for non-listed assets such as P2P loans, real estate, or anything without a market code

First import and asset matching

CSV import does not create assets or choose a provider automatically. Create a missing asset explicitly (a provider is optional); an existing asset can be selected manually or matched automatically when its saved identifiers give a unique match. An issuance/CUM ISIN can differ from the traded ISIN, and tickers can be ambiguous. Keep the appropriate primary and alternate identifiers on the asset so later imports can recognize it.

Non-listed assets (P2P loans, crowdfunding, real estate)

Use a consistent name string as the identifier (e.g. the project name). During BRIM import review you will be asked to map it — choose asset type OTHER since these are not exchange-traded instruments.

If the BUY transaction has no obvious identifier in a dedicated column, extract the project name from the description field in your conversion script.

docs.title: 🔀 When to Use Each Transaction Type
🔀 Multi-leg broker rows
docs.text:
Some broker events are one source row but several LibreFolio transactions. The correct model is to emit multiple TXCreateItems on the same date rather than hiding economics inside one row:

Broker event LibreFolio transactions Securities-only cash buy DEPOSIT for funding + BUY for the security Securities-only sale/redemption SELL for the security + WITHDRAWAL for cash swept away Bond maturity above par SELL at par principal + INTEREST for the above-par premium/FOI amount Portfolio snapshot seed DEPOSIT for cash when present + one cashless ADJUSTMENT per holding

This mirrors shipped broker plugins such as Intesa Sanpaolo (snapshot seed) and Crédit Agricole (automatic cash counter-entries and bond maturity split).

docs.title: 🤝 P2P lending / crowdfunding patterns
docs.text:
P2P platforms often issue a single report row that bundles capital repayment and interest. You need to split this into two transactions for LibreFolio:

Platform event LibreFolio transactions Principal repayment only SELL (quantity=−fraction, amount=+principal) Interest only INTEREST (amount=+interest) Principal + interest on same row Two rows: SELL at exact cost basis + INTEREST for the earnings Tax on interest TAX (amount=−tax, same date as interest)

Example: P2P project repayment

Project "VIA SILONE": bought 1 unit at €3,005. Partial repayment of €300.50 capital + €15.00 interest.

date,type,quantity,amount,currency,asset,description
2024-06-01,SELL,-0.100000,300.50,EUR,VIA SILONE,Rimborso parziale capitali
2024-06-01,INTEREST,,15.00,EUR,VIA SILONE,Interessi progetto VIA SILONE

The SELL quantity is −300.50 / 3005 = −0.100000 — the fraction of the 1-unit position being returned.

docs.title: ↩️ Storno / reversal of a broker error
docs.text:
When a broker incorrectly credits an amount and then reverses it, you have two options:

Option A — Clean history (recommended when the error and reversal are close in time)

Delete both the erroneous credit and the reversal from your CSV. If they were on the same day, just net the amounts: record only the true net value as a single transaction.

This keeps your portfolio charts clean with no artificial spikes.

Option B — Exact ledger (when the two events are weeks or months apart)

Record the reversal as the opposite transaction of the original: - If the error was a SELL (cash in), the reversal is a WITHDRAWAL (cash out, same amount negative) - If the error was a DEPOSIT, the reversal is a WITHDRAWAL

Do NOT use ADJUSTMENT for cash reversals

ADJUSTMENT must have an empty amount — it is strictly for quantity-only corrections (stock splits, share gifts). Using ADJUSTMENT for a cash reversal will leave the cash balance wrong.

docs.title: 💸 Fees and taxes
docs.text:
FEE and TAX are cash-only transactions (no quantity, no asset required):

date,type,amount,currency,description
2024-06-01,TAX,-28.31,EUR,Ritenuta d'acconto su interessi
2024-06-01,FEE,-1.50,EUR,Commissione operativa

docs.title: 🔍 How It Works: A Deeper Look
1️⃣ Column Detection (_detect_columns)
docs.text:
Maps the CSV's header row to LibreFolio's standard fields using a synonym dictionary:

HEADER_MAPPINGS = {
    "date": ["date", "data", "settlement_date", ...],
    "type": ["type", "tipo", "operation", ...],
    "asset": ["asset", "symbol", "ticker", "isin", ...],
    # ...
}

Each header is trimmed and lower-cased before the lookup (csv_col.lower().strip()). Headers that match no synonym are ignored, and when two headers map to the same field the leftmost wins.

The same map drives detection: can_parse — through cannot_parse_reason — accepts a .csv only when both date and type are mapped, so the wizard offers the plugin only for such files. If the user forces it on another file, parse_file refuses it with Plugin 'broker_generic_csv' cannot parse file '<name>': required column 'date' not found in the CSV header (HTTP 400), and the file moves to failed.

docs.title: 2️⃣ Row Parsing (_parse_row)
docs.text:
1. Extract Values via column_map
  2. Parse Date — tries multiple strptime formats
  3. Parse Type — looks up lowercase string in TYPE_MAPPINGS
  4. Parse Numbers — handles US and European decimal formats
  5. Handle Assets — classifies identifier as ticker/ISIN/name; assigns consistent fake asset IDs for batch mapping in BRIM review

Errors. An exception raised for a row — an empty or unreadable date, an unknown type, a TRANSFER (refused: it needs a link_uuid pair), a currency code that fails the ISO 4217 check — becomes the warning Row N: <message> (the header is row 1) and the row is skipped. A row that parses but breaks a business rule (signs, missing cash; see validate_transaction_business_rules) is not created either: _create_transaction records it in validation_issues. An asset-required type with an empty asset gets the placeholder identifier UNKNOWN_ROW_<n>, to be mapped in the review. The EUR default applies only when no currency column is mapped: with the column present, an empty cell on a row with an amount fails the ISO 4217 check, so that row is skipped. A file that yields no transaction adds the warning No valid transactions found in file.

docs.title: 📐 3. The "Gold Standard" Example
docs.text:
The Generic CSV Provider is the perfect starting point for a new broker plugin. Copy its structure and:

  1. Increase detection_priority to 100
  2. Add a can_parse() method to reliably detect your broker's file
  3. Customize HEADER_MAPPINGS and TYPE_MAPPINGS
  4. Refine parsing for any broker-specific quirks

docs.title: 📌 Complete Example Row by Row
docs.text:
This example shows a P2P portfolio lifecycle on a single platform (adapted from a real Recrowd import):

date,type,quantity,amount,currency,asset,description
2022-11-03,DEPOSIT,,6015.00,EUR,,Bonifico iniziale
2022-11-03,BUY,1,-3005.00,EUR,VIA SILONE,Investimento progetto VIA SILONE
2022-11-05,BUY,1,-2005.00,EUR,MARINA DI SCARLINO,Investimento progetto MARINA DI SCARLINO
2023-08-01,SELL,-0.031102,62.36,EUR,MARINA DI SCARLINO,Rimborso parziale capitali
2023-08-01,INTEREST,,15.20,EUR,MARINA DI SCARLINO,Interessi parziali
2023-08-01,TAX,,-3.95,EUR,,Ritenuta acconto interessi
2023-12-18,SELL,-1.000000,1005.00,EUR,EX ALBERGO VELA,Restituzione capitali completi
2023-12-18,INTEREST,,108.87,EUR,EX ALBERGO VELA,Interessi finali
2023-12-18,TAX,,-28.31,EUR,,Ritenuta 26% su interessi
2024-06-30,WITHDRAWAL,,-360.87,EUR,,Prelievo verso conto personale

Key points demonstrated:

  • DEPOSIT: positive amount, no asset, no quantity
  • BUY: positive quantity (receive units), negative amount (pay cash)
  • SELL: negative quantity (deliver units), positive amount (receive cash)
  • INTEREST: positive amount, asset optional, no quantity
  • TAX: negative amount, no quantity, no asset required
  • WITHDRAWAL: negative amount, no quantity, no asset

docs.title: 📦 BRIM Providers List
docs.text:
This page lists all the broker import plugins (BRIM Providers) currently available in LibreFolio.

Provider Code Formats Status Notes Interactive Brokers broker_ibkr CSV 🧪 Beta Reads an Activity Flex Query CSV whose first line holds the quoted Buy/Sell, TradeDate, ISIN and IBCommission columns (can_parse): buys and sells with an ISIN, each commission as a separate FEE. Rows without an ISIN (FX trades) are skipped; no dividends, taxes or cash movements. Degiro broker_degiro CSV ✅ Stable Account Statement CSV in any language, read by column position; currency conversions become linked FX_CONVERSION pairs (see Linked pairs). Notices in the file's language (EN, NL, DE, FR, ES; English otherwise). eToro broker_etoro CSV 🧪 Beta Reads the account activity CSV whose header holds Date, Type, Details, Amount, Units and Realized Equity: opened and closed positions as buys and sells, dividends, interest, deposits, withdrawals, and withdrawal and conversion fees. Ticker and currency come from Details (SYMBOL/CURRENCY). A CFD position is read like any other position; overnight fees, their refunds and UK stamp duty (SDRT) are skipped. Directa SIM broker_directa CSV, XLSX ✅ Stable Italian broker Directa; reads both CSV and XLSX (identical layout). Charles Schwab broker_schwab CSV 🧪 Beta Parses US-formatted CSV exports. Revolut broker_revolut CSV 🧪 Beta Handles both Revolut invest and crypto exports (variant auto-detected by header). Coinbase broker_coinbase CSV 🧪 Beta For crypto transactions from Coinbase. Freetrade broker_freetrade CSV 🧪 Beta For UK broker Freetrade. Finpension broker_finpension CSV 🧪 Beta Swiss pension platform. Trading212 broker_trading212 CSV 🧪 Beta Parses Trading212's standard CSV export. Avanza broker_avanza CSV 🧪 Beta Swedish broker; semicolon CSV, SEK, Swedish transaction types. Saxo Bank broker_saxo CSV 🧪 Beta Trades, dividends, cash transfers and custody fees; localized trade verbs supported. Swissquote broker_swissquote CSV 🧪 Beta Swiss broker; forex conversion legs are skipped with warnings. Trade Republic broker_traderepublic CSV 🧪 Beta European neobroker; semicolon CSV, EUR. XTB broker_xtb CSV 🧪 Beta Quantity/price parsed from the transaction comment field. InvestEngine broker_investengine CSV 🧪 Beta UK ETF broker; GBP, combined name/ISIN column. Parqet broker_parqet CSV 🧪 Beta Portfolio aggregator; semicolon CSV (underlying broker kept in description). Disnat broker_disnat CSV 🧪 Beta Canadian broker (Desjardins); French headers, CAD. BUX broker_bux CSV 🧪 Beta European neobroker; deposits, trades, dividends. Rabobank broker_rabobank CSV 🧪 Beta Dutch bank investing; EUR, semicolon CSV. Fineco broker_fineco CSV 🧪 Beta Italian bank; "Movimenti Dossier Titoli" report, both layout variants (with/without commissions). Verbatim amounts in the report currency (no FX). Intesa Sanpaolo broker_intesa CSV, XLSX 🧪 Beta Italian bank; auto-detects movements vs patrimonio snapshot. Movements map cedol*→INTEREST, dividend*→DIVIDEND, commission*→FEE, tax keywords→TAX, and skip unknown banking rows with warnings; snapshot seeds cash DEPOSIT when liquidity exists plus one ADJUSTMENT per holding with per-unit cost basis. Crédit Agricole broker_credit_agricole CSV, XLSX ✅ Stable Italian export ("Lista Movimenti Deposito Titoli" securities + "Lista Movimenti Conto" account movements). Name-only asset IDs, auto cash counter-entries for buy/sell, bond maturity split, succession legs as cashless ADJUSTMENT with origin causale in description. Italian-language warnings (language follows the input format). Danske Bank broker_danske_bank XLSX + CSV 🔬 Alpha Finnish equity savings account (osakesäästötili). Report set: the custody XLSX and the cash CSV, uploaded together, are combined into one file that pairs every trade with its cash movement and carries the bank's truth points (balance and proven positions) for the gap-fix. Finnish-language notices. See Multi-report plugins. Scalable Capital broker broker_scalable CSV ✅ Stable Broker account: Scalable's own CSV (PRIME and PRIME+ plans; 14 columns, ;, decimal comma) or the broker file of the LibreFolio exporter (the same 14 columns, then lf_*), told apart by the header — the account by the lf_account values, never by the file name. Executed rows only: trades on the gross amount with FEE and TAX legs on the same asset, dividends and interest gross (amount + tax) with a TAX leg, cash rows by the sign of amount. The transaction id (lf_id, then reference) ends each description. Shares _scalable.py with broker_scalable_deposit and refuses that account's file with a code: see Saying why with a code. Scalable Capital overnight account broker_scalable_deposit CSV ✅ Stable Overnight account: the LibreFolio exporter's file only, since Scalable's app has no export for it. Interest gross with a TAX leg, deposits and withdrawals; the transfers to the broker account stay DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL and are merged into CASH_TRANSFER pairs in the bulk editor, since a pair links two brokers. Refuses the broker account's files with a code. Investimental broker_investimental CSV 🧪 Beta Romanian broker; order-log export — imports final executed orders only. Crypto.com broker_cryptocom CSV 🧪 Beta Crypto; buys/rewards imported, internal transfers/swaps skipped. CoinTracking broker_cointracking CSV 🧪 Beta Crypto tracking export; fiat trades and staking (crypto↔crypto skipped). Delta broker_delta CSV 🧪 Beta Crypto portfolio tracker; crypto↔crypto trades modeled as adjustments. Bitvavo broker_bitvavo CSV 🧪 Beta Dutch crypto exchange; buys/sells/deposits/withdrawals, staking as adjustment. Relai broker_relai CSV 🧪 Beta Bitcoin-only app; CHF fiat. Generic CSV broker_generic_csv CSV ✅ Stable Fallback provider. Accepts any CSV matching the Generic CSV spec.

docs.title: 🧪 Status Levels
docs.text: Level Meaning 🔬 Alpha Early development — may have significant bugs 🧪 Beta Tested with sample files — edge cases may exist ✅ Stable Well-tested and reliable for supported formats

docs.title: 🏦 Scalable Capital Importers
docs.text:
broker_scalable and broker_scalable_deposit import the two accounts of Scalable Capital, each into a LibreFolio broker of its own: the broker account (Scalable Capital broker) and the overnight account (Scalable Capital overnight account). They live in backend/app/services/brim_providers/broker_scalable/plugin.py and broker_scalable_deposit/plugin.py (plugin_version 1.0.0, .csv only, detection_priority 100), which hold only their properties and calls to the shared reader, _scalable.py: recognition, refusals and parsing are written once, for both accounts. The leading underscore keeps _scalable.py out of the registry's auto-discovery.

This page covers what is specific to Scalable. The user's view is Scalable Capital, where the docs_url of both plugins points.

docs.title: 🗂️ Files and detection
docs.text:
Every file starts with the 14 columns of Scalable's own CSV export (PRIME_COLUMNS):

date;time;status;reference;description;assetType;type;isin;shares;price;amount;fee;tax;currency
File Header Read by Scalable's own CSV — PRIME and PRIME+ plans, broker account only the 14 columns broker_scalable The LibreFolio exporter's broker file the 14 columns, then lf_*; lf_account is broker broker_scalable The exporter's overnight account file the 14 columns, then lf_*; lf_account is deposit broker_scalable_deposit
  • Recognition (read_file, behind can_parse): a .csv whose first line holds the 14 columns, in any case and any order, split on the delimiter the base class detects. Without an lf_account column the file is Scalable's own CSV, always the broker account; with it, the lf_account values give the account — broker, deposit, both (mixed), or none for an export without rows, which both plugins accept. The file name is never read: the user may rename the file. A file that cannot be read is simply not a Scalable export: recognition never raises.
  • Refusals (refusal): each plugin refuses the other account's file, and both refuse a mixed one, with a code and — except for the mixed file — the plugin that reads it. The codes are listed in Saying why with a code. Any other file gets no refusal.
  • Values are read by column name. The 14 columns use the decimal comma (to_decimal_it) and date is YYYY-MM-DD. Of the exporter's own columns, described in its format, the reader uses lf_account, lf_id, lf_subtype, lf_is_cancellation, lf_ordered_shares and lf_account_index.

docs.title: 📝 What is imported
docs.text:
_Reader takes the data rows in file order. A reversal (lf_is_cancellation is true) and a row whose status is not Executed or Settled are left out, and so is a row without a readable date, amount or currency. Then type, compared lower-case, decides:

In the file (type) Imported as Buy, Savings plan BUY on the gross amount — the value of the shares, as Scalable's CSV and exporter 1.0.1 or later write it — with fee as a FEE and a positive tax as a TAX of the same asset. A negative tax, given back, becomes a DEPOSIT without asset Sell SELL, the same way a type containing Distribution DIVIDEND, gross — amount plus the tax withheld in tax — with that tax as a TAX of the same asset; net when tax is empty Interest INTEREST, gross, with the tax withheld as a TAX, both without asset; net when tax is empty Deposit, Withdrawal — bank transfers, and transfers between the two accounts DEPOSIT, WITHDRAWAL Fee FEE, without asset Taxes, Tax TAX, without asset; a positive amount, a refund, becomes a DEPOSIT Any other row whose assetType is Cash, such as a bonus DEPOSIT or WITHDRAWAL, by the sign of amount Security transfer, Corporate action and any other type Not imported: the scalable_not_imported notice lists them
  • Signs: a cash row whose sign contradicts its type — a negative Deposit, a positive Withdrawal or Fee — is booked by its sign, and so is a negative dividend or interest (scalable_cash_by_sign). A cash row, a dividend or an interest of zero is not imported (scalable_not_imported).
  • Trades without their details: in an exporter file, an empty fee means the details were not read, and the trade is booked on amount as it is, without legs (scalable_fees_unknown).
  • Exporter 1.0.0 is not supported: its trades carry the fee and the tax inside amount (added on a purchase, taken away on a sale), so both would be counted twice; the user exports again with 1.0.1 or later.
  • Only executed rows are imported. A Pending row with lf_ordered_shares and some shares already executed is an order filled in part (scalable_open_partial): it comes, executed, with a later export. The other statuses go to scalable_not_executed.
  • Assets: one fake asset id per ISIN — per description when the row has no ISIN — counting down from FAKE_ASSET_ID_BASE in order of first use, with extracted_isin and extracted_name (description) and no symbol; only the assets of written transactions are returned. The user matches them to LibreFolio's assets in the wizard's Review step. A trade or a dividend with neither ISIN nor description is unreadable.
  • Descriptions (_description): an optional leg prefix — Order fee, Tax, Tax refund — then the row's description (its type when empty, Scalable Capital when both are) cut to 350 characters, then id <lf_id> in exporter files and ref <reference> when the row has one, joined by ·. The id keeps two identical movements of one day apart and lets a new export recognise the rows already imported: the deduplication makes a match on the key fields LIKELY, unticked, only when the descriptions match too. Only the exporter's descriptions carry id …, so a row imported from one layout comes back from the other as a POSSIBLE duplicate, ticked.
  • Transfers between the two accounts (lf_subtype CASH_TRANSFER_IN or CASH_TRANSFER_OUT) are imported as plain DEPOSIT and WITHDRAWAL and listed by scalable_internal_transfers: a CASH_TRANSFER links two brokers, so the user merges the two halves in the bulk editor (Transfers). A merged half still matches when it is exported again (Merged transfers and exchanges).
  • Tags: import and scalable (_TAGS), from both plugins, so the two halves of a merged transfer carry the same tags. Both plugins declare history_tag scalable to match: broker_scalable by default, broker_scalable_deposit by override, since its default would be scalable_deposit.
  • Amounts are copied from the file, never recomputed or converted — a gross dividend or interest is the sum of amount and the tax withheld — and the currency comes from each row's currency: a value that is not an ISO 4217 code makes the row unreadable.

docs.title: 🔔 Notices
docs.text:
_NOTICES holds the eleven notices in display order, each with its severity, an English message and the comment of its evidence table. A notice comes only when it has rows, with context.count and one BRIMEvidence: those rows under the file's header, with their line numbers and an empty title, so the wizard captions the table itself. The wizard words the message as importWizard.brimNotice.<code> and the comment as importWizard.brimEvidence.<code>, keys present in the four catalogues; the English texts are the fallback (Talking to the import wizard).

Code Severity Rows scalable_unreadable_rows warning A date, an amount, a currency, the shares or the security missing or unreadable: not imported scalable_fees_unknown warning Exporter rows without their fee and tax details: imported on the amount shown, without legs scalable_open_partial warning Orders filled in part and still open: not imported yet scalable_reversal warning Reversals of a transaction already booked: not imported scalable_not_imported warning Security transfers, corporate actions, other types and zero amounts scalable_several_overnight_accounts warning The first row of each overnight account (lf_account_index), when the file holds more than one: they all go into one broker scalable_not_executed info Pending, cancelled, expired or rejected rows scalable_internal_transfers info Transfers between the two accounts: imported, to be merged scalable_dividends_net info Dividends without tax: imported net scalable_tax_refund info Tax refunds: imported as DEPOSIT scalable_cash_by_sign info Cash rows of an unknown type, or with an unexpected sign: booked by the sign of amount
